en.headline: Customs seize HK$8.3 million illicit cigarettes in Tsing Yi flat
en.dek: Officers raided a 600-square-foot private-estate unit used as a storage, packing and distribution centre, arresting a 28-year-old local man after finding about 1.86 million suspected untaxed cigarettes.
body: Hong Kong Customs said officers smashed an illicit-cigarette storage and distribution centre hidden in a private housing estate in Tsing Yi on Wednesday afternoon, seizing about 1.86 million suspected illicit cigarettes with an estimated market value of about HK$8.3 million and a duty potential of about HK$6.1 million.

Customs said officers on anti-illicit-cigarette patrol at about 1 p.m. saw a man loading large nylon bags onto a seven-seater at an estate car park. A search of the bags found large quantities of suspected illicit cigarettes and the 28-year-old local man was arrested.

Further inquiries led officers to a residential flat of about 600 square feet in the same estate. Inside they found more suspected illicit cigarettes, including batches already packed for distribution. Customs said the suspect had been sorting brands into parcels for supply across Hong Kong, and that crime groups had used the relatively private setting of an estate flat as a storage, packing and distribution hub.

The department said the investigation continues and further arrests are not ruled out. Under the Dutiable Commodities Ordinance, dealing in illicit cigarettes carries a maximum penalty of a HK$2 million fine and seven years’ imprisonment.

zh.headline: 海關青衣私樓搗私煙倉 檢186萬支煙拔28歲男子
zh.dek: 關員在青衣私人屋苑約600平方呎單位檢獲約186萬支懷疑私煙，市值約830萬元，應課稅值約610萬元。
body: 香港海關表示，周三下午在青衣一個私人屋苑搗破隱藏的私煙儲存、包裝及分銷中心，檢獲約186萬支懷疑私煙，估計市值約830萬元，應課稅值約610萬元，並拘捕一名28歲本地男子。
關員約下午1時在青衣反私煙巡查，於屋苑停車場發現一名男子將多個大型尼龍袋搬上一輛七人車。截查後在袋內搜獲大批懷疑私煙，當場拘捕該名男子。
深入調查後，關員鎖定同一屋苑內一個面積約600平方呎的住宅單位，再檢獲大批懷疑私煙，當中包括已預先分裝的貨品。海關指涉案男子將不同品牌私煙分類包裝後分銷至全港各區，犯罪集團意圖利用保安較嚴密的私人屋苑單位作為倉存及分銷據點。
案件仍在調查，不排除有更多人被捕。根據《應課稅品條例》，處理、管有、售賣或購買私煙，一經定罪最高可罰款200萬元及監禁7年。
